question: Two circles with radii r₁=7 cm and r₂=3 cm have their centers 20 cm apart. Find the length of the transverse common tangent between them.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two circles with radii r₁ and r₂, and distance between centers d, the formula is:

Transverse Common Tangent = √(d² − (r₁ + r₂)²)

TCT = √(20² − (7 + 3)²)

TCT = √(400 − 100) = √300 cm

**∴ The correct answer is √300 cm.**
